headline: Anthropic reports Claude Opus 5 processed raw NMR and LC-MS files for one contract-lab sample
summary: Anthropic’s Aug 18, 2026 technical report describes Claude Opus 5 using Claude Science to analyze raw NMR and LC-MS files from one routine contract-research-organization quality-control sample. Anthropic reports separate analyses completed in 23 and 19 minutes and compares them with that laboratory’s own processing and records. The report details a self-correction in its NMR interpretation and file-integrity checks for 2,664 mass-spectrometer scans. The headline purity figures use different peak sets: Anthropic reports 96.4% for three peaks, while the CRO report gives 96.33% for seven; the technical report calculates 98.8% from Claude’s own areas on the CRO’s peak basis. This is a detailed first-party account of one sample, not independent replication or evidence of general chemistry automation, therapeutic discovery, or broad productivity impact.
